method: Non-negative weighted least squares (weight 1/(workers+200)), chome workers ~ sum over 用途 of floor area, no intercept. Buildings assigned to chome by point-in-polygon; unsurveyed floor area = mesh footprint x learned floor/footprint ratio by height band.
sources: 国土交通省 Project PLATEAU 3D都市モデル 横須賀市 (2020年度), https://www.geospatial.jp/ckan/dataset/plateau-14201-yokosuka-shi-2020; PDL1.0. Modified: extracted and aggregated by chome.
perWardNote: single unit (no wards): no leave-ward-out check is possible; r2 is in-sample.
